cards.text: John, the servant God showed these visions to, is writing them down for the seven churches (Revelation 1:1, 4). He just watched the earth get harvested with a sickle (Revelation 14:14-16). Now he sees another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues.

cards.question: John says these seven plagues are the final ones. With them, the ___ of God is completed.

cards.text: Next John sees something like a sea of glass mixed with fire. Standing beside it are the ones who conquered the beast John saw rise out of the sea (Revelation 13:1), along with its image and the number of its name.

cards.question: The people standing beside the sea of glass are holding harps from God.

cards.text: Harps from God, friend, and the only instrument I've EVER played is an oven timer. Then they start to sing.

cards.question: These singers are standing beside a sea after a victory, and their song is named after two. One is the Lamb. Who is the other?
In their song, they praise God as King of the nations and ask who won't fear Him. What reason do they give?

answers.text: Because the sea obeys His voice

cards.question: The song says only a few nations will ever come and worship before God.

cards.text: After this, John looks, and the temple in heaven, the tabernacle of the Testimony, is opened.
Out of the temple come the seven angels with the seven plagues, dressed in clean and bright linen. Friend, I have NEVER kept an apron that clean past the first batch.

cards.question: One of the four living creatures around God's throne (Revelation 4:6) hands the seven angels seven golden ___ full of the wrath of God.
Once the temple fills with smoke from God's glory and power, anyone can still walk in until the plagues begin.

cards.text: Then John hears a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, “Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath.”

cards.question: The first angel pours his bowl on the earth. Who do the loathsome, malignant sores break out on?

answers.text: Those with the mark of the beast
The kings who came from the East

cards.text: The second angel pours his bowl into the sea, and it turns to blood like that of the dead. The third angel pours his into the rivers and springs of water, and they turn to blood too.

cards.question: When the second angel's bowl turns the sea to blood, every living thing in the sea ___.

cards.text: Then John hears the angel of the waters speak: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.”

cards.question: The angel of the waters says God has given these people blood to drink, as they deserve. What reason does he give?

answers.text: They spilled the blood of saints and prophets
They poisoned the rivers and springs
They tore down the temple of God

cards.question: When the angel of the waters finishes, the altar answers and agrees that God's judgments are true and just.

cards.text: Now the fourth angel pours his bowl on the sun. And the sun is given power to scorch people with fire.

cards.question: Scorched by the intense heat, the people repent and give God glory.

cards.text: The fifth angel pours his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom is plunged into darkness. Men gnaw their tongues in anguish.

cards.question: After the fifth bowl plunges the beast's kingdom into darkness, the men there gnaw their tongues in pain. What do they do next?

answers.text: They curse the God of heaven

cards.text: The sixth angel pours his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water dries up.

cards.question: Why is the great river Euphrates dried up?

answers.text: To prepare the way for the kings of the East
To let God's people cross over safely
To end the plague of blood in the rivers

cards.text: Then John sees three unclean spirits that look like frogs, coming out of the mouths of the dragon, who is the devil and Satan (Revelation 12:9), the beast, and the false prophet, who performs signs on the beast's behalf (Revelation 19:20). If anything that looked like a frog ever showed up in my bakery, friend, I'm diving face-first into the chocolate chips and I am NOT coming out.

cards.question: These demonic spirits perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth. They gather the kings for ___ on the great day of God the Almighty.

cards.text: Then, right in the middle of the bowls, the passage says: “Behold, I am coming like a thief.”

cards.question: Right after the words about coming like a thief, the one who remains awake and clothed is called blessed.

cards.text: Awake and clothed, so he won't go naked and have his shame exposed. That's my whole job up here, friend: apron on, ovens ready, and NOBODY touches the snooze button.
And they assemble the kings at the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
Then the seventh angel pours his bowl into the air. And a loud voice comes from the throne in the temple.

cards.question: This is the seventh of the seven final plagues. What does the loud voice from the throne say?
Next come flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and an earthquake. How mighty is the quake?

answers.text: The greatest since people have been on the earth
Strong only inside the great city
Too faint for most people to notice

cards.question: The great quake splits the great city into three parts, and the cities of the nations ___.

cards.text: And God remembers Babylon the great, the one an angel already called fallen back in Revelation 14:8.

cards.question: God gives Babylon the great the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.

cards.text: Every island flees, and no mountain can be found. Then great hailstones, almost a hundred pounds each, rain down from above.

cards.question: When the hail falls, men curse God for the plague of hail, because it is so horrendous.
